name: 548. Perplexity native /v1/responses usage: per-tool counts and the vendor's cost; vendor_cost on chat and Responses (perplexity vendor cost)
description: TXE-6987, contract C5, C10. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, whose perplexity entry points at tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs. Perplexity serves every model outside the Sonar family from its own /v1/responses (the Agent API), which Bifrost reaches through the shared Responses handler. The fixture answers /v1/responses for agent-usage in the published ResponsesUsage shape: tool_calls_details.<tool>.invocation and a cost object in US dollars (input_cost, output_cost, tool_calls_cost, total_cost); streamed, response.completed carries the same usage after one of Perplexity's own response.reasoning.* events. Before TXE-6987 the shared decode had no field for tool_calls_details, so the per-tool counts were dropped on this route, and no Perplexity usage carried vendor_cost. Rows 1-3 pin the native route (non-streamed, streamed, streamed on the OpenAI-compatible route): tool_usage.per_tool, tool_usage.web_search, cost with the vendor's total, and vendor_cost {amount: total_cost, unit: usd}. Rows 4-6 pin vendor_cost on the chat routes, where sonar-search-usage reports a flat cost whose total_cost is 0.03026. The usage shape is from Perplexity's published schema; no recorded native reply was available.
